title: Concept: Quarkus Dev UI served
description: Dev UI prints the runtime configuration, which includes datasource URLs and often credentials, plus the extension list that identifies the exact framework surface. It exists only in dev mode, so seeing it also proves the deployment is a development build.
applicability: Responses from a Quarkus application running in dev mode.
risk: The caller reads configuration values and the extension list, and can reach the dev services the application started.
